newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners 750 MW unit 4 seen down through Tues.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners 750 MW unit 4 seen down through Tues.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was scheduled to come off line late Friday and was expected to be down until Tuesday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said.
The unit was shut for because of clinker problems, they said.
Four Corners' 750 MW unit 5 was taken off line earlier this month to repair a ground, or dead spot, in its high pressure generator field.
Unit 5 is scheduled to restart around August 6.
Four Corners' 245 MW unit and two 185 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital, operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Edison International's Southern California Edison owns 48 percent of units 4 and 5.
